Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2005 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
DOUBLE ENDED CLAMPS 

(First Revision } 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions material and other requirements for double ended clamps used in 
holding work pieces in place when they are being machined. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. Designation — A double ended clamp having c/ = 1 4 mm and / = 1 25 mm shall be designated as: 

Double Ended Clamp 14 x 125 IS : 6080 

4. Material — Steel suitably hardened and tempered to a tensile strength of 750 to 850 N/mm^. 

5. Finish —The double ended clamps shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. These 
shall also be free from sharp corners. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment shall be given to double ended clamps. 

6.2 The double ended clamps shall be packed in accordance with best trade practice. 

7. Marking 

7.1 The double ended clamps shall be marked at an appropriate place with designation, manufacturer's 
name or trade-mark. 

7.2 IS! Certification l\/larking— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1971. The committee responsible for formulation of this 
standard decided to revise the same to bring it in line with other standards on clamps, which are also 
being revised in respect of material, tolerance, roughness values and rationalization of sizes. 

In the present revision, 120° chamfer on dimension fl^ has been deleted. Nine more sizes of 
double ended clamps have been included to suit screw sizes I\/I20, M24 and M30. 



Adopted 29 May 1985
